sources: Exact prior reviewed production/dependency bindings, frozen results/reporting references, retained fixture generator, finalized evidence seal, verified monitor, new helper/protocol and clean interpreter. Prepared bindings must match before launch; all sources and copied raw input bytes remain unchanged through completion.
fixture: Retained result_storage_measurement_2026-10-06/helper.py generate_inputs(count=600), written from iterator factories. Frozen results/reporting run on raw_fixture before current publication; current uses a byte-identical copied analysis view. Generated source/PTS/attribution carry their prior explicit synthetic limitations.
counters: Forward original ResultStorage._one/_execute/_encode/_decode within one isolated child. SQL counters classify only fixed source templates, without parameters, expanded SQL, values, evidence or unbounded sets. Encode/decode depth guards time only outer calls; nested calls are counted but never double-timed. No global JSON patch, source edit, pipeline or live product.
costAccounting: Each stage records elapsed nanoseconds, method calls, fixed SQL category counts/spans, top-level private encode/decode calls/spans and unassigned elapsed. _one includes execute/fetch/close; _execute includes execute/close. Commit callbacks outside methods, parser grammar, stdlib loads/dumps outside codec functions, public JSON encoding, repeated validation, CSV/chart logic and file I/O remain unassigned. Wrapper/clocks/depth guard overhead makes instrumented time unsuitable as uninstrumented throughput or causal attribution.
checks: Complete saved JSON, reader JSON, summary, CSV and HTML compare exact bytes against frozen references with no exclusions. Reader JSON digest equals saved JSON digest. Source/helper/protocol and every generated original/copied input hash match before/after. Predicted CSV length reads 9N+5 and payload reads 5N must match counters for this dense fixture; mismatch is retained as failed hypothesis evidence.
monitoring: Reuse hardened verified OwnedProcessTree helper SHA256 8a6789800d16cc8decb5f6441169ca1a6705bfdd30ba4de2a1a04ad725b18c39. Actual interpreter waits <=10s for atomic exact PID/createTime sampling acknowledgment before imports/work. Parent samples wrapper/remembered descendants and aggregate RSS/private, requires every owned identity retired on normal exit, and cleans only exact owned identities deepest-first plus original Popen handle fallback on failure.
retention: Exclusively create run and case; refuse reuse. Preserve first failure, all logs/partials/receipts/input/database/exports, never retry, never touch original media/saved production rows/public demo/live workers.
interpretation: Counter-based mechanism diagnostic only. One 600-frame instrumented child does not qualify speed, variance, real-video/full-match capacity, dense-pose/full-result/browser memory or scientific accuracy. Prior larger benchmark is retained unchanged; no whole benchmark is repeated by this protocol.
